standards.text: The learners demonstrate an understanding of the principles of aquaculture, use and maintenance of tools and equipment, and factors in site selection and pond preparation.
The learners perform maintaining tools, materials and equipment, site selection and pond preparation appropriate to local industry.
The learners demonstrate an understanding of the principles in designing aquaculture facilities, record keeping, hatchery operations, and broodstock and spawning management.
The learners perform management of hatchery, and broodstock and spawning in aquaculture following industry practices.
The learners demonstrate an understanding of the process of stocking aquaculture species, feeding management and stock sampling computations.
The learners perform stocking of aquaculture species, feeding management and stock sampling computations.
The learners demonstrate an understanding of the principles of water quality management, health management, harvest and post-harvest activities, and marketing of aquaculture products.
The learners perform monitoring of water quality parameters, health management practices, harvest and post-harvest activities, and marketing of aquaculture products.
